questions.stem: Child at birth appeared short. Out of the following which child has best prognosis for growth after birth?
questions.stemHtml: Child at birth appeared short. Out of the following which child has best prognosis for growth after birth?

options.label: B
options.text: Baby with birth length and weight is less than 10th percentile

options.label: C
options.text: Baby born to parents who are themselves below the 3rd percentile

options.label: D
options.text: Baby with birth length, weight and head circumference is less than 10th percentile
